scripts.dev: npm run seed && wrangler dev --config wrangler.local.toml --ip 0.0.0.0 --test-scheduled
scripts.build: npm run seed && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply prnews --local --config wrangler.local.toml
scripts.seed:db: npm run seed && tsx scripts/seed-db.ts && wrangler d1 execute prnews --local --config wrangler.local.toml --file .wrangler/seed.sql
